head: 92e1ff635f580cf462f7d557a4fe8f801553676c
title: fix(coach): Clients list reads every client and shows how each one is doing (UX-COACHLOOKUP-124)
body:
UX-COACHLOOKUP-124 (agent 124). T3: coach Clients list (store paging and filter meaning, row content, sort, refresh). 851 changed lines.

## Why (owner 12:10: "Easy to use? Key information displayed simply per client? Find whats broken, unintuitive, or ugly")
- **B1** A coach with more than 20 clients could not see, search, count or message anyone past the 20 newest: GET /coach/clients answers 20 rows a page and the roster read one page (Clients list, Home count, Messages list all read this store).
- **B2** After a look at the Archived filter, Home and Messages listed archived clients only: `loadClients()` with no status read whatever filter the Clients list was left on.
- **U** Each row showed only name, email and the word "active": nothing told the coach who logged today, who has gone quiet or who has check-ins waiting. "All" read active clients only; "N total" counted search results; Archived with none offered the first-client invite flow; no pull to refresh; the list went stale after archiving a client and coming back; search "ana lo" did not find Ana Lopez.

## What
- `coachStore.loadClients`: reads every page (50 a page, cursor = last id, page cap 40); a failed page fails the whole load (never a partial roster shown as whole). No status means active; the Clients list passes its filter; All sends `status=all`. Default filter Active. `silent` reload keeps the list on screen.
- `utils/coach/clientRoster.ts` (new, pure): activity block reader, display name, every-word search, sort (A to Z / most recent log), row line ("Logged today", "Last logged 4 days ago", "Joined Sep 1 · Nothing logged yet", "Logs not shared"), review badge, count line.
- `ClientsListScreen`: row = initials, name, last-log line (dot: green recent, amber after 3 quiet days), "N to review" badge, Archived tag; chips Active / Archived / All; Name/Recent sort toggle; header "12 active clients · 3 check-ins to review" ("3 of 12" while searching); pull to refresh; silent reload on return; stale-list notice when a reload fails; Archived empty state; privacy banner says clients choose what they share.

## Server pair and merge order
Backend growth-project-backend#777 adds the per-row `activity` block (consent-gated per scope). Without it (older server) every row falls back to "Joined <date>" and everything else works, so either merge order is safe. Old app + new server: unchanged readers (#777 body lists them).

## Tests
`src/screens/coach/__tests__/ClientsListLookup124.test.tsx` (new). B1 and B2 tests fail on main (main reads one page; main sends the left-over Archived filter). Two existing Clients list suites get `clients: []` and a no-op `addListener` in their mocks.

Not touched: ClientDetailScreen, client-detail/*, services/api.ts, CoachNavigator.
